ICD-10-CM Expert 2026/2025 Index Tabs with Color-Coded Tabs and Easy to Use Blank Tabs
Looking for a way to make studying ICD-10-CM coding even easier? Look no further than our Expert 2026/2025 Index Tabs! Designed specifically for use with the ICD-10-CM Expert 2026/2025 code book, these color-coded tabs make it quick and easy to find the perfect code for your diagnosis.
Features:

items: Laminated Color-coded tabs provide a durable and easy-to-read option for quick reference
Blank tabs included for your own personal use or to replace damaged ones
Alignment Card included to ensure perfect alignment of the tabs

blocks.text:
Product Description The ICD-10-CM Expert 2026/2025 is the most recent update to the widely popular ICD-10-CM coding system, providing healthcare professionals with the latest codes and guidelines for accurate diagnosis coding. With the help of our Expert 2026/2025 Index Tabs, finding the perfect code has never been easier!
Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting out in the field of healthcare, our Expert 2026/2025 Index Tabs will save you valuable time and energy when it comes to coding. Quickly and easily find the code you need, ensuring accurate and efficient coding in no time!
Perfect for use with all ICD-10-CM Expert editions, these durable tabs are a must-have for any serious healthcare coder. So why wait? Order your Expert 2026/2025 Index Tabs today and take the guesswork out of coding!

items.label: SUFFICIENT QUANTITY
items.value: 56 Clear PVC Laminated Tabs in Total (2 Sheets) 50 Book Tabs for ICD-10-CM Expert 2026/2025 The Complete Official Codebook (AAPC Version) and 6 Blank tabs included for your own personal use or to replace damaged ones with 1 Bookmark and Placement Template (Book Not Included)

items.label: CLEAR AND EASY NAVIGATION
items.value: Our color-coded tabs have large font and are printed on both sides so you can easily navigate the 1392 pages of the AAPC's ICD-10-CM Expert 2026/2025 code book. PS: Our book index tabs are compatible with the 2026 editions of the AAPC ICD-10-CM books. Please note that the page reference information on the current tabs is based on the 2025 editions and is not yet applicable to the 2026 versions. When using the tabs, please verify the actual page numbers in the new editions independently.

items.label: TIME SAVING
items.value: A page that tells you where to put each tab on so that you don't waste precious time flipping through the pages looking for the right regulations. The Tabs are removable when applying and will become permanent over time, so if you want to adjust the position when installing, you can remove flags and reapply.

items: EASY TO INSTALL： Perforated to allow easy fold and alignment. Double-sided flag technology allows you to view information on both sides of the logbook.Color-Coded, Easy to Navigate: Tabs of the same part are of the same or similar color, so it’s very easy for you to find different sections. PS: Only sell index tabs, Book Not Included.

items.label: DURABLE AND WATERPROOF
items.value: You can easily reference any book or passage with these tabs, which have clear print on both sides. We adopt high quality printing material, and all the tabs are laminated with film, so they are durable and waterproof, can last for long time.
